cars.body_style: Closed two-door Touring sporting GT coupe
cars.specification_market: Audrain collection-listed 1952 Series II Touring coupe, chassis 0149, used as a restored museum reference for the original Z-102 production-road family. Eleven construction and equipment attributes follow the museum account; they do not authenticate all historical components or factory dates. Nominal 2.5-litre engine designation retained, without exact cc conversion, power/torque standards, gearing or independent timed performance. No transfer of supercharged record-car speeds, competition equipment, Cupula show-car details, later Z-103 specifications or new Ricart-branded revival claims. Group original Z-102 road engines, bodies and individual chassis once. Photo is a different Touring coupe, categorized as 1955 chassis 153.0162, illustrating road family/body only, not the reference car or engine.
cars.summary: The Pegaso Z-102 represents an ambitious Spanish sporting-GT engineering programme: a quad-cam V8 with dry-sump lubrication, a rear-mounted five-speed transmission and lightweight Touring coachwork. This combination gives the road family a distinctive place in early post-war performance-car history. Count the original Z-102 road family once, without multiplying coachbuilders, engines or chassis.
